description: Only for an assistant that can send the user's file with HTTP PUT, such as a coding agent with a shell. Begins uploading a world archive (.zip, .tar.gz, .tgz; up to 4 GiB). Returns jobId, uploadId, key and parts (partNumber, url valid one hour): PUT each piece to its url, keep each ETag, then call completeWorldUpload. Refused while another upload, export or restore is pending.

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. world.zip.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: startWorldUpload
title: Start uploading a world archive
